newsitem.title: USA: American Financial and unit weigh exchange.
newsitem.headline: American Financial and unit weigh exchange.

text.p: American Financial Group and its subsidiary, American Financial Enterprises Inc said they are considering an exchange of stock.

Under the plan, all the shares of AFEI common stock that are not owned by AFG would be exchanged for AFG common stock on a share- for-share basis. AFG and AFEI intend that the transaction be structured so that it is tax-free to AFEI holders.
The transaction would be further subject to the approvals of AFG's and AFEI's boards of directors, a majority of AFEI's shareholders other than AFG and any requisite listing and regulatory approvals.

It is expected that AFEI's board will appoint the non-AFG member of its board to examine the feasibility of such a transaction. His review will be assisted by independent counsel and independent investment advisor.
AFEI presently has 13,291,117 shares outstanding. Holders other than AFG and its subsidiaries own about 2.3 million AFEI shares.
